block.tfmg.firebox.tooltip.summary: Heats machinery when fuel is pumped inside
block.tfmg.firebox.tooltip.condition1: When filled with lpg, butane, diesel, propane, naphta or kerosene with carbon dioxide being pumped out
block.tfmg.firebox.tooltip.behaviour1: Heats machinery above it acting as a blaze burner
block.tfmg.winding_machine.tooltip.summa: Changes the amount of turns on spools and the resistance on resistors
block.tfmg.winding_machine.tooltip.behav: Right click with your desired item (Electromagnetic Coil or Resistor) and then right click with either a Copper spool for Coils and an Aluminium one for resistors. Interact with it to set the amount of turns/ohms and power with rotation. Use the Engineers goggles to see when your winding is finished.
block.tfmg.surface_scanner.tooltip.summa: Helps to find chunks with oil
block.tfmg.surface_scanner.tooltip.condi: When powered from below with a Machine Input
block.tfmg.surface_scanner.tooltip.behav: The machines top 5x5 grid shows the surrounding chunks with its chunk in the center, the chunks that have atleast 1 oil deposit in them should glow. If the surface does not start to glow within a few seconds then it is likely that there are no oil deposits nearby. Chunks can be seen ingame with F3+G
block.tfmg.casting_basin.tooltip.behavio: Creates steel ingots which must have a sufficent output as the internal storage of the basin is limited
block.tfmg.neon_tube.tooltip.behaviour1: Glows relative to the amount of power its receiving
block.tfmg.neon_tube.tooltip.behaviour2: Changes color to the color of the light when glowing
block.tfmg.neon_tube.tooltip.behaviour3: Changes shape providing a space to power the tube
block.tfmg.light_bulb.tooltip.behaviour1: Glows relative to the amount of power its receiving
block.tfmg.light_bulb.tooltip.behaviour2: Changes color to the color of the light when glowing
block.tfmg.circular_light.tooltip.behavi: Glows relative to the amount of power its receiving
Changes color to the color of the light when glowing
block.tfmg.modern_light.tooltip.behaviou: Glows relative to the amount of power its receiving
Changes color to the color of the light when glowing
block.tfmg.aluminum_lamp.tooltip.behavio: Glows relative to the amount of power its receiving
Changes color to the color of the light when glowing
item.tfmg.oil_can.tooltip.condition1: When Right Clicking a tank with lubrication oil inside
item.tfmg.oil_can.tooltip.behaviour1: Fills the can with lubrication oil
item.tfmg.oil_can.tooltip.behaviour2: Fills the engine with lubrication oil
block.tfmg.copper_cable_hub.tooltip.summ: Carries power through a chain of hubs
block.tfmg.copper_cable_hub.tooltip.cond: When placed next to another hub or connector
block.tfmg.copper_cable_hub.tooltip.beha: Acts as a cable: rated for _16 A_, above that the hub overloads
block.tfmg.brass_cable_hub.tooltip.summa: Carries power through a chain of hubs
block.tfmg.brass_cable_hub.tooltip.condi: When placed next to another hub or connector
block.tfmg.brass_cable_hub.tooltip.behav: Acts as a cable: rated for _50 A_, above that the hub overloads
block.tfmg.aluminum_cable_hub.tooltip.su: Carries power through a chain of hubs
block.tfmg.aluminum_cable_hub.tooltip.co: When placed next to another hub or connector
block.tfmg.aluminum_cable_hub.tooltip.be: Acts as a cable: rated for _80 A_, above that the hub overloads
block.tfmg.steel_casing_cable_hub.toolti: Carries power through a chain of hubs
When placed next to another hub or connector
Acts as a cable: rated for _100 A_, above that the hub overloads
block.tfmg.heavy_cable_hub.tooltip.summa: Carries power through a chain of hubs
block.tfmg.heavy_cable_hub.tooltip.condi: When placed next to another hub or connector
block.tfmg.heavy_cable_hub.tooltip.behav: Acts as a cable: rated for _100 A_, above that the hub overloads
block.tfmg.steel_cable_hub.tooltip.summa: Carries power through a chain of hubs
block.tfmg.steel_cable_hub.tooltip.condi: When placed next to another hub or connector
block.tfmg.steel_cable_hub.tooltip.behav: Acts as a cable: rated for _250 A_, above that the hub overloads
block.tfmg.concrete_hose.tooltip.summary: Pours _Liquid Concrete_ into rebar structures below it
block.tfmg.concrete_hose.tooltip.conditi: When rotated, then STOPPED, with liquid concrete piped in
block.tfmg.concrete_hose.tooltip.behavio: Lowers its hose while turning and fills every _concretable_ block it can reach once stopped. Only blocks that accept concrete (rebar) are filled, plain blocks stop the spread
item.tfmg.lithium_charge.tooltip.conditi: When held anywhere in the inventory and the blade is R-Clicked
item.tfmg.lithium_charge.tooltip.behavio: One charge is consumed and the blade is set alight
block.tfmg.segmented_display.tooltip.sum: Shows a line of text or a number, driven by a _Display Link_
block.tfmg.segmented_display.tooltip.con: When targeted by a Display Link
block.tfmg.segmented_display.tooltip.beh: Shows whatever the link's source provides. Place several side by side for a longer line
block.tfmg.segmented_display.tooltip.con: When used as the SOURCE of a Display Link
block.tfmg.segmented_display.tooltip.beh: Passes its own contents on to another display
item.tfmg.electricians_wrench.tooltip.be: Stores a group number on the wrench. Nothing reads that number yet: the tool has no effect on any block in this version
item.tfmg.transmission.tooltip.summary: Links an engine to an _Engine Controller_
item.tfmg.transmission.tooltip.behaviour: The controller's position is stored on the transmission
item.tfmg.magnet.tooltip.summary: Crafting component. Survives fire and lava
item.tfmg.magnet.tooltip.behaviour1: One magnet is applied during the sequence
item.tfmg.coal_coke.tooltip.summary: Furnace fuel that burns for _3200 ticks_, twice as long as coal
item.tfmg.coal_coke_dust.tooltip.summary: Burns as long as _Coal Coke_, 3200 ticks
item.tfmg.steel_vertical_gearbox.tooltip: Places a _Steel Gearbox_ turned on its side
The axis follows a neighbouring shaft, or the way you are facing
item.tfmg.pipe_bomb.tooltip.behaviour1: Thrown like a snowball, then _3 seconds_ before another can be thrown
item.tfmg.engine_cylinder.tooltip.summar: Decides which fuels an engine will burn
item.tfmg.engine_cylinder.tooltip.behavi: The engine only runs on the fuels listed on this item
item.tfmg.simple_engine_cylinder.tooltip: Decides which fuels an engine will burn
The engine only runs on the fuels listed on this item
item.tfmg.diesel_engine_cylinder.tooltip: Decides which fuels an engine will burn
The engine only runs on the fuels listed on this item
item.tfmg.turbine_blade.tooltip.summary: The moving part of a _Turbine Engine_
item.tfmg.turbine_blade.tooltip.conditio: When inserted into a Turbine Engine
item.tfmg.turbine_blade.tooltip.behaviou: One blade goes into each block of the engine
item.tfmg.electromagnetic_coil.tooltip.s: Sets the voltage ratio of a _Transformer_
item.tfmg.electromagnetic_coil.tooltip.c: When placed on both sides of a Transformer
item.tfmg.electromagnetic_coil.tooltip.b: Output voltage is input voltage times output turns divided by input turns. Both coils need at least _50 turns_, and equal turns change nothing
item.tfmg.unfinished_electromagnetic_coi: Wound in a _Winding Machine_ to make an _Electromagnetic Coil_
When wound with a copper spool
The number of turns wound becomes the coil's turn count
item.tfmg.unfinished_resistor.tooltip.su: Wound in a _Winding Machine_ to make a _Resistor_
item.tfmg.unfinished_resistor.tooltip.co: When wound with a constantan spool
item.tfmg.unfinished_resistor.tooltip.be: The turns wound set the resistance in Ω, shown on the item
item.tfmg.unfired_insulator.tooltip.summ: Cut from clay, fired into an _Unfinished Insulator_
item.tfmg.unfinished_insulator.tooltip.c: When crafted with the rest of the recipe
item.tfmg.oil_hammer.tooltip.summary: Reads what is left in an oil deposit
item.tfmg.oil_hammer.tooltip.condition1: When R-Clicking the ground above a deposit
item.tfmg.oil_hammer.tooltip.behaviour1: Reports the remaining reserves. Looks up to _300 blocks straight down_ and finds nothing anywhere else
item.tfmg.mixer_blade.tooltip.summary: Puts an _Industrial Mixer_ into mixing mode
item.tfmg.mixer_blade.tooltip.condition1: When R-Clicked onto an Industrial Mixer
item.tfmg.mixer_blade.tooltip.behaviour1: One blade at a time. Recipes that ask for mixing then run in the vat below
item.tfmg.centrifuge.tooltip.summary: Puts an _Industrial Mixer_ into centrifuge mode
item.tfmg.centrifuge.tooltip.condition1: When R-Clicked onto an Industrial Mixer
item.tfmg.centrifuge.tooltip.behaviour1: Replaces the blade. Recipes that ask for centrifuging then run in the vat below
item.tfmg.limesand.tooltip.summary: _Flux_. Binds the impurities in a Blast Furnace
item.tfmg.limesand.tooltip.condition1: When fed to a Blast Furnace
item.tfmg.limesand.tooltip.behaviour1: Satisfies the flux an industrial blasting recipe asks for
item.tfmg.graphite_electrode.tooltip.sum: Goes into an _Electrode Holder_ under a vat
item.tfmg.graphite_electrode.tooltip.con: When R-Clicked onto an Electrode Holder
item.tfmg.graphite_electrode.tooltip.beh: Recipes that call for this electrode can run. Inserting a different one swaps them, inserting the same one does nothing
item.tfmg.copper_electrode.tooltip.summa: Goes into an _Electrode Holder_ under a vat
item.tfmg.copper_electrode.tooltip.condi: When R-Clicked onto an Electrode Holder
item.tfmg.copper_electrode.tooltip.behav: Recipes that call for this electrode can run. Inserting a different one swaps them, inserting the same one does nothing
item.tfmg.zinc_electrode.tooltip.summary: Goes into an _Electrode Holder_ under a vat
item.tfmg.zinc_electrode.tooltip.conditi: When R-Clicked onto an Electrode Holder
item.tfmg.zinc_electrode.tooltip.behavio: Recipes that call for this electrode can run. Inserting a different one swaps them, inserting the same one does nothing
item.tfmg.empty_circuit_board.tooltip.co: When a Deployer applies the coating
item.tfmg.coated_circuit_board.tooltip.c: When etched in a chemical vat
item.tfmg.etched_circuit_board.tooltip.c: When run through the sequenced assembly
item.tfmg.etched_circuit_board.tooltip.b: Capacitors, resistors and transistors are applied in turn until it becomes a Circuit Board
item.tfmg.unfinished_circuit_board.toolt: The circuit board part way through its assembly
Becomes a Circuit Board. Taking it off the belt early keeps the progress on the item
item.tfmg.circuit_board.tooltip.summary: The brain of the advanced machines
item.tfmg.circuit_board.tooltip.behaviou: Needed by the Electric Pump, the Fireproof Chemical Vat, the Segmented Display, the Traffic Light and the Lithium Blade
item.tfmg.silicon_ingot.tooltip.conditio: When mixed with the right dopant
item.tfmg.silicon_ingot.tooltip.behaviou: Becomes an N or P Semiconductor. Also used in Magnetic Alloy and the Segmented Display
item.tfmg.n_semiconductor.tooltip.behavi: One of each type makes an Electric Diode; both are consumed by the Transistor assembly
item.tfmg.p_semiconductor.tooltip.behavi: One of each type makes an Electric Diode; both are consumed by the Transistor assembly
item.tfmg.capacitor_item.tooltip.summary: Stores charge. Built by sequenced assembly
item.tfmg.capacitor_item.tooltip.behavio: Goes into the Electric Pump, the Polarizer, the Voltage Observer and the Circuit Board
item.tfmg.transistor_item.tooltip.summar: Switches a circuit. Built by sequenced assembly from doped silicon
item.tfmg.transistor_item.tooltip.behavi: Goes into the Voltage Observer and the Circuit Board
item.tfmg.unfinished_capacitor.tooltip.s: The _Capacitor_ part way through its assembly
The _Transistor_ part way through its assembly
item.tfmg.unfinished_generator.tooltip.s: The _Generator_ part way through its assembly
item.tfmg.unfinished_electric_motor.tool: The _Electric Motor_ part way through its assembly
item.tfmg.unfinished_potentiometer.toolt: The _Potentiometer_ part way through its assembly
item.tfmg.unfinished_steel_mechanism.too: The _Steel Mechanism_ part way through its assembly
item.tfmg.unprocessed_heavy_plate.toolti: The _Heavy Plate_ part way through its assembly
item.tfmg.steel_mechanism.tooltip.summar: The core component of the heavy machines
item.tfmg.steel_mechanism.tooltip.behavi: Needed by the Engine Gearbox, the Industrial Mixer, the Large Switch, the Machine Input and both Pumpjack parts
item.tfmg.heavy_plate.tooltip.behaviour1: Needed by the Blast Furnace Reinforcement, the Steel Chemical Vat, the Regular Engine, the Mixer Blade and the Lithium Blade
item.tfmg.crankshaft.tooltip.summary: The first part an engine asks for
item.tfmg.crankshaft.tooltip.behaviour1: Slots into the engine. No recipe uses it: it is placed by hand, before the cogwheels, the belt, the pipes and the mechanism
item.tfmg.spark_plug.tooltip.summary: Lets a cylinder burn a second kind of fuel
item.tfmg.spark_plug.tooltip.condition1: When crafted onto an Engine Cylinder
item.tfmg.spark_plug.tooltip.behaviour1: The cylinder gains the fuels of the plugged recipe. Also used in the Flamethrower and the Lithium Blade
item.tfmg.turbo.tooltip.summary: Engine upgrade. More power, more fuel
item.tfmg.turbo.tooltip.behaviour1: _+30%_ speed and _+20%_ torque, and the engine burns about _40%_ more fuel. One per engine block, and the effect multiplies across them
item.tfmg.golden_turbo.tooltip.summary: Engine upgrade. More power than the Turbo, and no extra fuel
item.tfmg.golden_turbo.tooltip.behaviour: _+30%_ speed and _+40%_ torque, and fuel use is untouched
item.tfmg.rebar.tooltip.summary: Cut from steel. The skeleton of reinforced concrete
item.tfmg.rebar.tooltip.condition1: When placed as a Rebar Block, Floor or Pillar and covered in Liquid Concrete
item.tfmg.rebar.tooltip.behaviour1: Dries into the reinforced concrete of the same shape
item.tfmg.screw.tooltip.behaviour1: Needed by the Engine Gearbox, the Industrial Mixer and the Steel Mechanism assembly
item.tfmg.fireclay_ball.tooltip.behaviou: Becomes a Fireproof Brick. Four of them make a block of Fireclay
item.tfmg.empty_spool.tooltip.summary: Cut from _Hardened Planks_. Holds _1000 turns_ of wire
item.tfmg.empty_spool.tooltip.behaviour1: Becomes a full spool of that metal
item.tfmg.copper_spool.tooltip.behaviour: Draws a cable between them and spends turns with the distance. Runs out and it becomes an Empty Spool
item.tfmg.copper_spool.tooltip.condition: When mounted on a Winding Machine
item.tfmg.copper_spool.tooltip.behaviour: Feeds winding recipes: coils, resistors, and the winding steps of a sequenced assembly
item.tfmg.aluminum_spool.tooltip.behavio: Draws a cable between them and spends turns with the distance. Runs out and it becomes an Empty Spool
item.tfmg.aluminum_spool.tooltip.conditi: When mounted on a Winding Machine
item.tfmg.aluminum_spool.tooltip.behavio: Feeds winding recipes: coils, resistors, and the winding steps of a sequenced assembly
item.tfmg.constantan_spool.tooltip.behav: Draws a cable between them and spends turns with the distance. Runs out and it becomes an Empty Spool
item.tfmg.constantan_spool.tooltip.condi: When mounted on a Winding Machine
item.tfmg.constantan_spool.tooltip.behav: Feeds winding recipes: coils, resistors, and the winding steps of a sequenced assembly
item.tfmg.copper_wire.tooltip.condition1: When crafted onto an Empty Spool
item.tfmg.copper_wire.tooltip.behaviour1: Fills the spool with 1000 turns of this metal
item.tfmg.aluminum_wire.tooltip.conditio: When crafted onto an Empty Spool
item.tfmg.aluminum_wire.tooltip.behaviou: Fills the spool with 1000 turns of this metal
item.tfmg.constantan_wire.tooltip.condit: When crafted onto an Empty Spool
item.tfmg.constantan_wire.tooltip.behavi: Fills the spool with 1000 turns of this metal
item.tfmg.thermite_grenade.tooltip.behav: Bursts into _20 sparks_ that set orange fire where they land, and an explosion that _breaks no blocks_
item.tfmg.zinc_grenade.tooltip.behaviour: Bursts into _20 sparks_ that set green fire where they land, and an explosion that _breaks no blocks_
item.tfmg.copper_grenade.tooltip.behavio: Bursts into _20 sparks_ that set blue fire where they land, and an explosion that _breaks no blocks_
item.tfmg.thermite_powder.tooltip.summar: Burns hot enough to keep going anywhere
item.tfmg.copper_sulfate.tooltip.behavio: Yields _4 Bone Meal_, sometimes more, and cyan or blue dye
item.tfmg.sulfur_dust.tooltip.summary: Feeds most of the chemistry line
item.tfmg.sulfur_dust.tooltip.behaviour1: Goes into Sulfuric Acid, Rubber, N Semiconductors and Gunpowder
item.tfmg.nitrate_dust.tooltip.behaviour: Goes into Sulfuric Acid and Gunpowder
item.tfmg.bauxite_powder.tooltip.summary: Crushed bauxite, the start of aluminum
item.tfmg.bauxite_powder.tooltip.conditi: When processed in a chemical vat
item.tfmg.slag.tooltip.summary: What the Blast Furnace leaves behind. Not waste
item.tfmg.slag.tooltip.behaviour1: Replaces part of the recipe in both the Concrete and the Asphalt Mixture
item.tfmg.bitumen.tooltip.summary: Compacted from the heaviest distillation cut
item.tfmg.synthetic_leather.tooltip.beha: Sits in the common leather tag, so recipes asking for leather accept it. Also converts to vanilla leather
item.tfmg.synthetic_string.tooltip.behav: Sits in the common string tag, so recipes asking for string accept it
item.tfmg.rubber_sheet.tooltip.summary: Made in a chemical vat from sulfur
item.tfmg.rubber_sheet.tooltip.behaviour: Insulates the Cable Tube and the Diagonal Cable, seals the Fireproof Chemical Vat, and goes into the Engine Controller
item.tfmg.fire_extinguisher.tooltip.summ: Puts out fires with dry ice. Holds _500_ charges
item.tfmg.fire_extinguisher.tooltip.beha: Sprays flakes that clear fire blocks and put out any entity they touch, one charge per tick
item.tfmg.fire_extinguisher.tooltip.cond: When filled with _Carbon Dioxide_ by a Spout
item.tfmg.fire_extinguisher.tooltip.beha: Refills to full. A freshly crafted one already is
item.tfmg.lead_sword.tooltip.behaviour1: _5 seconds_ of Poison, added on top of any poison already running. Costs 2 durability a hit
item.tfmg.lead_axe.tooltip.summary: Poisons what it hits, longer than the sword
item.tfmg.lead_axe.tooltip.behaviour1: _8 seconds_ of Poison, added on top of any poison already running. Costs 2 durability a hit
item.tfmg.lit_lithium_blade.tooltip.summ: The Lithium Blade while it burns. Lasts _100 seconds_
item.tfmg.lit_lithium_blade.tooltip.beha: _7 seconds_ of Hellfire, which relights the victim even out of water, and stacks with itself
Throws a burst of _10 sparks_, spends 5 seconds of burn time, then waits 3 seconds. It reverts to the unlit blade when the time runs out
item.tfmg.napalm_potato.tooltip.conditio: When loaded into the Advanced Potato Cannon
item.tfmg.napalm_potato.tooltip.behaviou: The only projectile that cannon takes. Made by filling a potato with _500 mB of Napalm_ at a Spout
item.tfmg.cooling_fluid_bottle.tooltip.s: Carries _4000 mB_ of Cooling Fluid to an engine
item.tfmg.cooling_fluid_bottle.tooltip.c: When R-Clicking any tank, vat or pipe holding Cooling Fluid
item.tfmg.cooling_fluid_bottle.tooltip.b: Pours its contents into the engine. Sneak + R-Click empties it instead
item.tfmg.magnetic_alloy_sheet.tooltip.b: Goes into the Transformer and the Laminated Magnetic Alloy Block the Large Transformer needs
item.tfmg.plastic_sheet.tooltip.behaviou: Goes into the Plastic Pipe, the Empty Circuit Board, the Cooling Fluid Bottle, the Lithium Charge and the Napalm Bomb
item.tfmg.fireproof_brick.tooltip.behavi: Builds the Fireproof Bricks a Coke Oven is made of, and the Casting Basin
item.tfmg.cinderblock.tooltip.summary: Cast from _Liquid Concrete_, or cut from concrete
item.tfmg.cinderblock.tooltip.behaviour1: Eight of them plus rebar and liquid concrete make a Cinder Block
item.tfmg.glass_insulator_segment.toolti: Crafting component. It is not a block and does not place
Where the Blast Furnace is _fed_, and where its metal comes out
When items are inserted, by hand, funnel or pipe
Fuel goes to the furnace's fuel counter, flux to the flux slot, and everything else to the ore input. Despite the name, this is the INPUT for items
Drains the two _4000 mB_ tanks holding the molten metal and the slag
block.tfmg.blast_furnace_hatch.tooltip.s: The tuyere. Blows hot air into the Blast Furnace
block.tfmg.blast_furnace_hatch.tooltip.c: When built into the furnace wall
block.tfmg.blast_furnace_hatch.tooltip.b: Holds _4000 mB_ of Hot Air that the recipe draws from. _Only one_ per furnace: a second one stops the wall being valid
block.tfmg.freezer.tooltip.condition1: When powered and touching a vat
block.tfmg.freezer.tooltip.behaviour1: Takes _one step_ of heat off it. Several stack. Needs more than _3 A_ to run, and it counts whether it sits above or below the vat
block.tfmg.compressor.tooltip.summary: Changes the pressure inside a chemical vat
block.tfmg.compressor.tooltip.condition1: When turning at _120 RPM_ or more
block.tfmg.compressor.tooltip.behaviour1: Raises the pressure one step. Reverse the rotation and it lowers it instead. Several stack, above or below the vat
block.tfmg.machine_input.tooltip.summary: Feeds rotation to a machine that sits _on top of it_
block.tfmg.machine_input.tooltip.conditi: When placed under a Pumpjack Crank
block.tfmg.machine_input.tooltip.behavio: Drives the crank, and the pumping speed follows its rotation
block.tfmg.machine_input.tooltip.conditi: When placed under a Surface Scanner
block.tfmg.machine_input.tooltip.behavio: The scanner only reads the ground while this turns at _64 RPM_ or more
block.tfmg.industrial_mixer.tooltip.summ: Drives the recipes of the vat below it
block.tfmg.industrial_mixer.tooltip.cond: When a _Mixer Blade_ or a _Centrifuge_ is R-Clicked onto it
block.tfmg.industrial_mixer.tooltip.beha: One attachment at a time. It decides which of the two families of vat recipes can run
block.tfmg.electrode_holder.tooltip.summ: Holds the electrode a vat recipe asks for
block.tfmg.electrode_holder.tooltip.cond: When an electrode is R-Clicked onto it
block.tfmg.electrode_holder.tooltip.beha: Swaps whatever was in it. Electrolysis recipes then match on the electrode's material
block.tfmg.creative_generator.tooltip.su: Creative power source. Supplies any voltage, without limit
block.tfmg.creative_generator.tooltip.co: When scrolled with the mouse wheel
block.tfmg.creative_generator.tooltip.be: Sets the voltage it puts out
block.tfmg.generator.tooltip.behaviour1: Voltage climbs with the speed past that floor and stops at _1000 V_. Below the floor it produces nothing at all
block.tfmg.rotor.tooltip.summary: The heart of the large alternator
block.tfmg.rotor.tooltip.condition1: When ringed by _exactly 8 Stators_ and driven above _70 RPM_
block.tfmg.rotor.tooltip.behaviour1: Produces far more than the Generator, up to _10000 V_. With any other number of stators it produces _nothing_
block.tfmg.stator.tooltip.condition1: When 8 of them ring a Rotor
block.tfmg.stator.tooltip.behaviour1: The alternator works. Seven or nine and it stays dead
block.tfmg.electric_motor.tooltip.behavi: Speed follows the voltage and tops out at _255 RPM_, which needs a little over _300 V_. Its stress capacity grows with that speed
block.tfmg.electric_pump.tooltip.behavio: Pumping pressure follows the voltage and tops out at _1500_, reached around _750 V_. No power, no flow
block.tfmg.air_intake.tooltip.summary: Draws in _Air_, faster the wider it is built
block.tfmg.air_intake.tooltip.behaviour1: Output rises with the _square_ of the width: a 2x2 makes four times what a single block does, a 3x3 nine times. The partial builds in between produce nothing
block.tfmg.coke_oven.tooltip.summary: Bakes coal into _Coal Coke_, and gives _Creosote_ with it
block.tfmg.coke_oven.tooltip.condition1: When built as a hollow cube of Fireproof Bricks
block.tfmg.coke_oven.tooltip.behaviour1: The bigger the cube, the faster it bakes: past 2 blocks across, time is divided by half the size. Coal takes _60 seconds_ in the smallest one
block.tfmg.electric_diode.tooltip.behavi: Power crosses towards the face it points at and never back. Rated _100 A_
Becomes an Encased Diode, which behaves the same
block.tfmg.encased_diode.tooltip.summary: An _Electric Diode_ inside a casing. Same behaviour
block.tfmg.encased_diode.tooltip.behavio: Power crosses towards the face it points at and never back. Rated _100 A_
block.tfmg.exhaust.tooltip.summary: Vents the _Carbon Dioxide_ an engine breathes out
block.tfmg.exhaust.tooltip.condition1: When piped to an engine's exhaust tank
block.tfmg.exhaust.tooltip.behaviour1: Holds _1000 mB_ and takes carbon dioxide only. An engine whose exhaust has nowhere to go stops, so give every engine somewhere to vent
block.tfmg.brick_smokestack.tooltip.summ: Chimney for _Carbon Dioxide_. Stack them and only the top one vents
block.tfmg.brick_smokestack.tooltip.cond: When stacked and fed carbon dioxide
block.tfmg.brick_smokestack.tooltip.beha: Each block passes its content up to the one above, and the topmost one releases it. Each holds _8000 mB_ and vents faster the more it has backed up
block.tfmg.concrete_smokestack.tooltip.s: Chimney for _Carbon Dioxide_. Stack them and only the top one vents
block.tfmg.concrete_smokestack.tooltip.c: When stacked and fed carbon dioxide
block.tfmg.concrete_smokestack.tooltip.b: Each block passes its content up to the one above, and the topmost one releases it. Each holds _8000 mB_ and vents faster the more it has backed up
block.tfmg.metal_smokestack.tooltip.summ: Chimney for _Carbon Dioxide_. Stack them and only the top one vents
block.tfmg.metal_smokestack.tooltip.cond: When stacked and fed carbon dioxide
block.tfmg.metal_smokestack.tooltip.beha: Each block passes its content up to the one above, and the topmost one releases it. Each holds _8000 mB_ and vents faster the more it has backed up
block.tfmg.cast_iron_chemical_vat.toolti: The first chemical vat. Runs the simplest recipes
When built as a hollow box with a Machine on top
Every vat recipe names the vats it accepts, and this one is on the fewest of them. Look at the recipe in JEI to see if it qualifies
block.tfmg.steel_chemical_vat.tooltip.su: The middle chemical vat. Runs more recipes than cast iron
block.tfmg.steel_chemical_vat.tooltip.co: When built as a hollow box with a Machine on top
block.tfmg.steel_chemical_vat.tooltip.be: Accepts most of the chemistry line. A recipe still has to name it, which JEI shows
block.tfmg.fireproof_chemical_vat.toolti: The last chemical vat. Runs everything the other two do, and more
When built as a hollow box with a Machine on top
The widest recipe list of the three. One recipe also needs a vat of at least _9 blocks_, so build big before blaming the tier
Nothing. This is the one vat whose windows cannot be toggled
block.tfmg.steel_fluid_tank.tooltip.beha: Capacity is the number of blocks times the per-block capacity from Create's own fluid tank setting. Growing it keeps what is already inside
block.tfmg.aluminum_fluid_tank.tooltip.b: Capacity is the number of blocks times the per-block capacity from Create's own fluid tank setting. Growing it keeps what is already inside
Capacity is the number of blocks times the per-block capacity from Create's own fluid tank setting. Growing it keeps what is already inside
block.tfmg.steel_distillation_controller: Splits crude oil into its fractions. It is _very_ particular about its tower
When the recipe has exactly as many fractions as the tower has outputs
It runs. A mismatch does nothing at all: crude oil splits into _6_ fractions, so it needs _6_ outputs. The lighter recipes need 5 and 3, and JEI shows which is which
When the boiler behind it is heated
Speed follows the heat. No heat, nothing happens
When the boiler is big enough
It must be at least _twice as tall_ as the number of outputs, and wider than one block past _3_ outputs
block.tfmg.steel_distillation_output.too: One stage of the tower. Each takes _one_ fraction
When stacked above the controller with pipe between them
The lightest fraction goes highest. Their count has to match the recipe exactly, so add or remove a stage to switch between the crude oil recipes
block.tfmg.pumpjack_base.tooltip.summary: Pumps _Crude Oil_ out of a deposit below it
block.tfmg.pumpjack_base.tooltip.conditi: When the pumpjack is complete and turning
block.tfmg.pumpjack_base.tooltip.behavio: Looks straight down for a deposit and fills its own tank. Output follows the crank's speed and pulses with the beam, so it is fastest mid-stroke
Deposits do not run dry in this version, whatever the config says
block.tfmg.pumpjack_crank.tooltip.summar: Turns rotation into the beam's stroke
block.tfmg.pumpjack_crank.tooltip.condit: When a _Machine Input_ is placed under it
block.tfmg.pumpjack_crank.tooltip.behavi: It reads that block's speed. Nothing else drives it, so no machine input means no pumping
block.tfmg.pumpjack_hammer.tooltip.summa: The beam. Links the crank to the base
block.tfmg.pumpjack_hammer.tooltip.condi: When built with its parts, head and connector
block.tfmg.pumpjack_hammer.tooltip.behav: The whole assembly has to be complete before anything pumps, and it re-forms by itself once a missing piece is put back
block.tfmg.electrical_switch.tooltip.sum: Passes voltage through in proportion to its _redstone signal_
block.tfmg.electrical_switch.tooltip.beh: Not just on or off: the voltage that crosses is the incoming voltage times the signal over 15. A signal of 7 passes about half
block.tfmg.large_switch.tooltip.summary: Heavy-duty switch, thrown by _rotation_ rather than redstone
block.tfmg.large_switch.tooltip.behaviou: One direction closes the arm, the other opens it, and the arm moves faster the faster you turn it. Rated _1000 A_
block.tfmg.large_switch.tooltip.conditio: When the line carries more than _1000 V_
block.tfmg.large_switch.tooltip.behaviou: It conducts before the arm has fully closed: the higher the voltage, the wider the gap the current jumps. An open switch on a high-voltage line does not fully isolate it
block.tfmg.voltmeter.tooltip.summary: A dial that reads _one_ quantity of the network it touches
block.tfmg.voltmeter.tooltip.behaviour1: Cycles what the needle shows: voltage, current, resistance, power, the network's total draw or generation, or an accumulator's stored charge
block.tfmg.voltage_observer.tooltip.summ: Turns the state of a circuit into redstone
block.tfmg.voltage_observer.tooltip.cond: When the line it touches carries any voltage at all
block.tfmg.voltage_observer.tooltip.beha: It emits a redstone signal. Zero volts, no signal
The strength follows the voltage and reaches full at _250 V_
block.tfmg.potentiometer.tooltip.summary: Passes a chosen _percentage_ of the voltage through.
block.tfmg.potentiometer.tooltip.conditi: When scrolled with the mouse wheel
block.tfmg.potentiometer.tooltip.behavio: Set anywhere from _0 to 100%_. Output is the incoming voltage times that share, so it dims a branch without touching the rest of the network
block.tfmg.encased_potentiometer.tooltip: Passes a chosen _percentage_ of the voltage through. Encased, and otherwise identical.
When scrolled with the mouse wheel
Set anywhere from _0 to 100%_. Output is the incoming voltage times that share, so it dims a branch without touching the rest of the network
block.tfmg.regular_engine.tooltip.summar: Burns fuel for rotation. Assembled by hand, in a fixed order
block.tfmg.regular_engine.tooltip.condit: When R-Clicked with each component in turn
block.tfmg.regular_engine.tooltip.behavi: It wants them in this order: _Crankshaft_, _Steel Cogwheel_, _Large Steel Cogwheel_, _Belt Connector_, _Steel Pipe_, _Steel Pipe_, _Steel Mechanism_. Wear the goggles and it names the piece it is waiting for

Insert one _Cylinder_ into each block of the engine, fill it with a fuel that cylinder accepts, and give it a _redstone signal_ - speed is a direct multiple of the signal, so no signal means no rotation however full the tank is
block.tfmg.radial_engine.tooltip.summary: Burns fuel for rotation. Assembled by hand, in a fixed order
block.tfmg.radial_engine.tooltip.conditi: When R-Clicked with each component in turn
block.tfmg.radial_engine.tooltip.behavio: It wants them in this order: _Crankshaft_, _Steel Cogwheel_, _Large Steel Cogwheel_, _Belt Connector_, _Steel Pipe_, _Steel Pipe_, _Steel Mechanism_. Wear the goggles and it names the piece it is waiting for

Insert one _Cylinder_ into each block of the engine, fill it with a fuel that cylinder accepts, and give it a _redstone signal_ - speed is a direct multiple of the signal, so no signal means no rotation however full the tank is
block.tfmg.turbine_engine.tooltip.summar: Burns fuel for rotation, with turbines instead of pistons
block.tfmg.turbine_engine.tooltip.condit: When R-Clicked with each component in turn
block.tfmg.turbine_engine.tooltip.behavi: Its own order, shorter than the piston engines: _Shaft_, _Steel Cogwheel_, _Steel Pipe_, _Steel Pipe_, _Steel Mechanism_, _Steel Mechanism_
Insert one _Turbine Blade_ into each block, fuel it, and give it a _redstone signal_
block.tfmg.large_engine.tooltip.summary: The heavy engine. It needs _air_ as well as fuel
block.tfmg.large_engine.tooltip.conditio: When fuelled but not supplied with air
block.tfmg.large_engine.tooltip.behaviou: It will not run. An empty air tank stops it just as surely as an empty fuel tank, so pipe an _Air Intake_ to it
It drives a shaft on its end rather than a cogwheel stack
block.tfmg.simple_large_engine.tooltip.s: The heavy engine in its plainer form. Same fuels, same _air_ requirement, less capacity
block.tfmg.simple_large_engine.tooltip.c: When fuelled but not supplied with air
block.tfmg.simple_large_engine.tooltip.b: It will not run. An empty air tank stops it just as surely as an empty fuel tank, so pipe an _Air Intake_ to it
It drives a shaft on its end rather than a cogwheel stack, and carries _40_ stress capacity where the regular one carries _55_. Everything else about the two is identical
block.tfmg.gas_lamp.tooltip.summary: Burns fuel for light. No wiring at all
block.tfmg.gas_lamp.tooltip.condition1: When filled with any flammable fluid or fuel
block.tfmg.gas_lamp.tooltip.behaviour1: Holds _4000 mB_ and burns roughly _1 mB every second_, so one filling lasts well over an hour. It stays lit a few seconds after the last drop
block.tfmg.cable_tube.tooltip.summary: Buried cable. Carries current along its own axis
block.tfmg.cable_tube.tooltip.behaviour1: Connects only at its two ends, never on the sides, and holds up to _10000 V_. Pour concrete over it and it dries into the encased version
block.tfmg.electric_post.tooltip.summary: Carries current the way a Cable Tube does, standing up
block.tfmg.electric_post.tooltip.behavio: Connects at its two ends only, and holds up to _10000 V_. Concrete poured over it dries into the encased post
Takes a cable run up or down at an angle
When placed between two cable blocks
Keeps the run connected across a change of height instead of forcing a step
block.tfmg.cable_connector.tooltip.condi: When 2 cable insulators are right clicked with a copper/aluminum/constantan spool
block.tfmg.cable_connector.tooltip.behav: Created a connection between the 2 insulators transferring power between them
block.tfmg.large_coil.tooltip.summary: Used for creating the Large Transformer
block.tfmg.large_coil.tooltip.condition1: When 2 Large Coils are placed next to each other and right-clicked with a Laminated Magnetic Alloy Block
block.tfmg.large_coil.tooltip.behaviour1: The Large Transformer is Created, to make it efficient, right-click it with a Block of Steel and a Lubrication Oil Bucket
block.tfmg.glass_cable_insulator.tooltip: When 2 cable insulators are right clicked with a copper/aluminum/constantan spool
Created a connection between the 2 insulators transferring power between them
block.tfmg.transformer.tooltip.summary: Changes the voltage in a circuit
block.tfmg.transformer.tooltip.behaviour: Needs 2 electromagnetic coils of different turn amounts that have to be put on the transformer where the output (indicated by a small line of copper) outputs voltage based on the ratio of the 2 coils (for example if the input has a coil with 50 turns and the output has one with a 100 then the voltage is doubled since 100/50 = 2)
block.tfmg.diode.tooltip.summary: Functions as a one way gateway for power to flow through
block.tfmg.diode.tooltip.condition1: When provided with power from its darker side
block.tfmg.diode.tooltip.behaviour1: The power will be outputted on its lighter side acting as a one way pathway for power (meaning any power that would be coming from its lighter side would not be outputted on the darker one)
block.tfmg.blast_stove.tooltip.behaviour: When 3 blast stoves are placed on top of eachother (or in a 3x2 shape) the smallest version of a blast stove is created, to add further internal storage you can add more stove blocks on top which is generally recommended. A Blast Stove requires 2 things to be pumped in. Air, from the side of the bottom block and Creosote or Furnace gas from the bottom. Carbon dioxide must be pumped out from the side of the bottom block and finally heated air must be pumped out from the machines top.
block.tfmg.resistor.tooltip.condition1: When placed on a block within a group
block.tfmg.resistor.tooltip.behaviour1: Adds the resistors respective resistance (to see how to change its resistance look at the winding machines tooltip) to whatever electric group its target block is in
block.tfmg.fireclay.tooltip.summary: Spawns in underground veins located in the overworld
item.tfmg.advanced_potato_cannon.tooltip: Launches _Napalm Potatoes_ at Enemies. Can be powered with _Air_ _Pressure_ from a _Backtank_
_No_ _Durability_ will be used. Instead, _Air_ _pressure_ is drained from the Tank
item.tfmg.flamethrower.tooltip.summary: Burns  burnable _Gases_ and _Fluids_ to shoot out a burst of flame to burn your Enemies
item.tfmg.flamethrower.tooltip.condition: When R-Clicking a Fluid Container with _Valid Fuel_ inside
item.tfmg.flamethrower.tooltip.behaviour: The _Fuel_ will be consumed from the tank. _Range_ and _Spread_ change according to your _Fuel_ of choice
item.tfmg.screwdriver.tooltip.behaviour1: Locks _Pipe_ in its current rotation allowing for _Pipes_ to be placed next to eachother _Without Connecting_
block.tfmg.polarizer.tooltip.summary: Makes Magnetis out of Magnetic Ingots
block.tfmg.polarizer.tooltip.behaviour1: Will turn a _Magnetic Ingot_ into a _Magnet_ when right clicked with a _Magnetic Ingot_ after a bit of time
item.tfmg.magnetic_alloy_ingot.tooltip.s: Striking this with a lightning might do something...
item.tfmg.lithium_blade.tooltip.summary: Using _Steel Ingot_Lithium Charges_, this Blade is set aflame burning enemies and shooting out Bolts of _Hellfire_
item.tfmg.lithium_blade.tooltip.behaviou: Is set on hellfire, consuming a _Lithium Charge_. Its flame sets enemies on fire for a set amount of time, this fire is renewed even after Enemy extinguishes themself in water
Shoots out several bolts of _Hellfire_ consuming the blades charge
block.tfmg.accumulator.tooltip.summary: Holds a Large Amount of energy (inserted from bottom) that can be outputted Slowly from the Top
item.tfmg.electrictians_wrench.tooltip.s: Changes the electrical group of a component
item.tfmg.electrictians_wrench.tooltip.b: Opens up a menu where you can choose the group of set block. Groups are explained within the generators ponder
block.tfmg.flarestack.tooltip.condition1: When Pumped burnable Fluids/Gases into from the bottom
block.tfmg.engine_controller.tooltip.sum: Controls the speed and direction of rotation generated by various types of engine
block.tfmg.engine_controller.tooltip.con: How to link to an engine
block.tfmg.engine_controller.tooltip.beh: R-Click the controller with a transmission item and then do the same with the engine.
Look in the Keybinds part of the minecraft settings specifically in the Create: The Factory Must Grow section
block.tfmg.converter.tooltip.summary: Converts FE to TFMG energy and vice versa
block.tfmg.converter.tooltip.behaviour1: The block has a TFMG input (copper) and an FE one (redstone) by default it converts TFMG energy to FE with a wrench you can make the converter convert FE to TFMG energy. Voltage of the tfmg output may be abjusted by opening a menu on the side of the Converter
block.tfmg.cocrete_hose.tooltip.summary: Pumps concrete like a hose pulley into rebar blocks. Set concrete dries as rebar concrete
item.tfmg.quad_potato_cannon.tooltip.sum: Launches 4 of your home-grown vegetables at Enemies. Can be powered with _Air_ _Pressure_ from a _Backtank_
item.tfmg.quad_potato_cannon.tooltip.beh: _No_ _Durability_ will be used. Instead, _Air_ _pressure_ is drained from the Tank
effect.tfmg.hellfire.description: Continuously reignites the victim: the fire relights every tick until the effect ends, even after extinguishing in water. Inflicted by the lit Lithium Blade.
